statements.text: Under the superseded 2022 guidelines, transfers in any category were restricted to not exceed 20% of the cadre strength of that category.
statements.quote: Transfers in any category shall not exceed 20% of the cadre strength of that category.

statements.text: The superseded 2022 guidelines relaxed the ban on transfers for the period from June 8, 2022, to June 30, 2022.
statements.quote: The ban on transfers is relaxed for the period from 08-06-2022 to 30-06-2022.

statements.text: Under the 2025 guidelines, which are not established, employees retiring on or before May 31, 2027, are not to be disturbed except on request.
statements.quote: Employees retiring on or before 31-05-2027 shall not be disturbed except on request.

statements.text: According to clarifications on the 2025 transfers, which are not established, periods of leave not exceeding six months are counted towards the station period.
statements.quote: Periods of leave not exceeding six months shall be counted towards the station period.

statements.text: The clarifications on the 2025 transfers, which are not established, state that periods of deputation outside the Department are not counted towards the station period.
statements.quote: Periods of deputation outside the Department shall not be counted.
